name: Midway Saloon
address: 1567 University Ave W, Saint Paul, MN 55104
description: This historic neighborhood bar pairs an unpretentious atmosphere with live music, local events, and an extensive whiskey and craft beer selection. Located steps from Allianz Field, it is a go-to Midway spot for weekly blues jams, local music showcases, and pre-game gatherings.

name: Ginkgo Coffeehouse
address: 721 Snelling Ave N, St Paul, MN 55104
description: This cozy coffeehouse serves espresso drinks, light eats, and baked goods in a family-friendly space. Beyond coffee, Ginkgo functions as a community hub hosting acoustic live music, art exhibitions, and seasonal maker fairs.

name: Sundin Music Hall
address: 1531 Hewitt Ave, St Paul, MN 55104
description: Located on the campus of Hamline University, this 325-seat concert hall is celebrated across the Twin Cities for its intimate, warm ambiance and recording-quality acoustics.

name: Turf Club
address: 1601 University Ave W, St Paul, MN 55104
description: This historic venue features live performances from national touring acts and local artists almost every night of the week. Operated by First Avenue, it offers a legendary main stage upstairs and a cozy basement hideaway in the Clown Lounge.

name: Urban Lights
address: 1449 University Ave W, St Paul, MN 55104
description: A cornerstone of the local music scene and one of Minnesota's premier Black-owned record stores, Urban Lights specializes in R&B, hip-hop, and gospel vinyl and CDs. The space doubles as an open house for creatives, regularly hosting block parties, DJ showcases, and open mics.

name: Hamline Park
address: 1564 Lafond Ave, St Paul, MN 55104
description: This neighborhood green space features a playground, futsal court, basketball courts, and open grassy areas. It offers a versatile outdoor venue for community gatherings, youth programming, and neighborhood events.

name: Jimmy Lee Rec Center
address: 270 Lexington Pkwy N, St Paul, MN 55104
description: Located within the Oxford Community Center in Saint Paul’s historic Rondo neighborhood, this facility provides top-tier athletic and recreational spaces. It acts as a vital neighborhood hub for youth sports, arts initiatives, and health and wellness activities.

name: Creative Writing House
address: 1500 Englewood Ave, St Paul, MN 55104
description: Home to Hamline University’s Creative Writing Programs, this dedicated campus residence supports emerging authors across fiction, poetry, and nonfiction. It serves as an anchor for literary workshops, student-led art collectives, and community literary events.

name: Black Garnet Books
address: 1319 University Ave W, St Paul, MN 55104
description: An independent, Black-owned bookstore dedicated to centering literature, poetry, and artwork by BIPOC authors and illustrators. The shop creates a welcoming environment focused on community care through book clubs, author events, and workshops.

name: Mosaic on a Stick
address: 1564 Lafond Ave, St Paul, MN 55104
description: Mosaic on a Stick is a vibrant St. Paul community art studio and retail shop dedicated to inspiring creativity through the art of mosaic. They offer a full supply of colorful tiles, glass, and tools alongside hands-on workshops for artists and makers of all skill levels.

name: Mamas Market and Deli
address: 678 Snelling Ave N #100, St Paul, MN 55104
description: Co-owned by nine Ethiopian immigrant mothers, Mamas Market & Deli is a welcoming neighborhood spot built on shared dreams and rich culture. They serve up fresh deli sandwiches, house-made smoothies, traditional Ethiopian coffee, and everyday market staples.

name: Vig Guitars
address: 595 Snelling Ave N, St Paul, MN 55104
description: VIG Guitars is an award-winning, Indigenous-owned music shop based in St. Paul, Minnesota. They specialize in expert luthier repairs, custom hand-wound pickups, and a curated selection of quality new and used instruments.

name: The Dubliner Pub
address: 2162 University Ave W, St Paul, MN 55114
description: The Dubliner Pub is a beloved St. Paul landmark known for its warm, authentic Irish hospitality and vibrant, community-centered atmosphere. A staple since 1983, it offers local drafts, regular live traditional Irish music, and a lively space for neighborhood gatherings.

name: Fluid Ink Tattoos
address: 597 Snelling Ave N, St Paul, MN 55104
description: Fluid Ink Tattoos is dedicated to high-quality body art in a clean, welcoming, and inclusive environment. Their team of experienced artists specializes in custom designs across a wide range of styles, working closely with clients to bring unique visions to life.

name: Hive Collaborative
address: 677 Hamline Ave N, St Paul, MN 55104
description: This intimate performance venue and creative space is dedicated to cultivating original local work and supporting artistic expression in the Midway. Its flexible setting offers an up-close look at inventive theater, live performances, and community talent.

name: Celtic Junction Arts Center
address: 836 Prior Ave N, St Paul, MN 55104
description: A cornerstone of Celtic heritage in the Twin Cities, this vibrant cultural center showcases traditional music, dance, and literary arts year-round. It serves as an energetic neighborhood cultural hub.

name: Black Hart of Saint Paul
address: 1415 University Ave W, St Paul, MN 55104
description: As Saint Paul’s premier LGBTQ+ soccer bar and event space, Black Hart is known for its electric atmosphere and welcoming neighborhood spirit. It serves as a lively hub for music, nightlife, and inclusive community gathering along University Avenue.

name: Can Can Wonderland
address: 755 Prior Ave N Ste 004, St Paul, MN 55104
description: Housed in a historic industrial building, this whimsical venue pairs artist-designed mini-golf and vintage arcade games with a bustling live performance stage. Its immersive, art-driven backdrop provides a unique entertainment space for visitors of all ages.

name: Elsa's House of Sleep
address: 1441 University Ave W, St Paul, MN 55104
description: A beloved family-owned Midway fixture since 1997, this local home furnishings landmark anchors the neighborhood with decades of history. It highlights the community-driven commercial tradition that continues to shape the surrounding district.

name: Anderson Center
address: 774 Snelling Ave N, St Paul, MN 55104
description: Serving as Hamline University’s primary student center, this modern space bridges campus life with the broader Saint Paul community. Its versatile gathering areas host campus events, public programming, and neighborhood gatherings.

name: Soeffker Gallery
address: 1530 W Taylor Ave, St Paul, MN 55104
description: Located on the Hamline University campus, this fine art gallery features rotating contemporary exhibitions from visiting artists, faculty, and emerging local talent.
